'''Norie''' is a ''[[damane]]'' in the [[Seanchan]] army.

== Activities ==
She accompanies [[Bakayar Mishima]] and [[Tylee Khirgan]] to the meeting with [[Perrin Aybara]]. There she puts out a fire started by [[Jur Grady]].
